report: Reviewed the complete claim, ordinary sage_ir::symbol implementation association and whole-file source, and the sole associated test sage_meta::todo::symbols_external_identity. Requirements are dependency identity by crate number and definition index, independence from requested metadata facts, and consistent adapter definition kind. SymExt stores crate_num and def_index, but also interns kind. Name and child queries use the definition pair; child construction includes provider kind. Thus the source supports pair-based metadata lookup but does not establish unconditional pair-only identity or enforce consistent kinds. The explicit TODO correctly identifies this existing limitation and reserves identity tests across metadata updates and rejection of inconsistent provider kinds. Its empty body has no behavioral assertions and proves none of these guarantees. Completing the deferred evidence requires establishing/enforcing canonical kind for each pair and adding identity assertions across different metadata requests/updates (including distinguishing different pairs), plus a conflicting-kind rejection case. These are justified existing implementation/verification prerequisites, not implemented guarantees; no new uncovered concern was inferred beyond that declared gap. No edits requested to the current TODO accounting. Baseline: personally confirmed current implementation and containing test files exactly match the historical snapshots; independently reassessed the supplied historical rationale against current inputs rather than treating that match as approval. Execution: ran review start and byte comparisons, and record for this report; no tests or build run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional sage-meta tests and root cargo build are separate execution evidence and do not discharge this TODO. No additional source dependencies were relied on.
